title: Music in the Republic of Karelia - Wikipedia
text: 12 stringed Karelian kantele in the National Museum of the Republic of Karelia Traditional music of Karelia is a form of music performed among Karelian people. It has been less influenced by Germanic elements than traditional Finnish music, which is why many Finnish musicians and other creators have used it as source of inspiration.
